title: Concept: Nominee or next-of-kin details in a response
description: A nominee block naming a person together with a relation or date of birth in a response gives every reader of that response the same information the bank holds internally: That combination identifies a third party who never consented to the disclosure, and it is enough to answer knowledge-based identity questions about the account holder.
applicability: A relative's identity and relationship are reusable facts: they unlock call-centre verification and social-engineering scripts.
risk: Nominee data is third-party personal data; the account holder is not the only data subject involved.
